about: Ten real messages sent after disasters (Haiti earthquake 2010, Hurricane Sandy 2012, Pakistan floods 2010), from the Disaster Response Messages data set. Some messages describe injury and death.
licence: Disaster Response Messages (Figure Eight / Appen, packaged by Robert Munro), CC BY 4.0. Keep this notice.

label_rules.need_type: From the source category columns, first match wins: rescue (search_and_rescue, missing_people), medical (medical_help, medical_products, hospitals), food_water (water, food), shelter, infrastructure (infrastructure_related, buildings, transport, electricity, other_infrastructure), otherwise other.
label_rules.kind: From the source columns: request, offer, otherwise report.
label_rules.translated: True when the source has an original message in another language.
label_rules.kept_words: Names and numbers found in both the original message and the source's English translation. They must survive translation.
label_rules.fact_check: The report has two sentences: the first comes from post 1 of the two posts (supported by it); the second comes from a message about a different need that is not in the posts (not_found).
label_rules.privacy: The last sentence of each privacy text (name, phone or student number, email) is made up and added by us, because the public source data has no personal details. 555-01xx phone numbers and example.com email addresses are reserved for examples.
